headline: Audi to Build $4 Billion Manufacturing Facility in the United States
summary: German automaker Audi announced plans to build a $4 billion manufacturing factory in the United States, with vehicle production slated to begin early next decade.
why: Large capital expenditure projects by multinational automakers can significantly impact regional employment, supply chains, and local manufacturing output.

impacts.name: Volkswagen AG
impacts.why: A multi-billion-dollar US investment expands North American production capacity but requires significant upfront capital expenditure.
